summary.headline: Sudarshan Q2 FY27 Legacy pigment revenue rose to INR821 crore (from INR651 crore), with total pigment business EBITDA at INR242 crore; Acquired Group FY27 guidance reaffirmed at EUR700m revenue and EUR35m EBITDA.
summary.overview: Management reported a stronger Q2 FY27, with Legacy Sudarshan pigment revenue of INR821 crore (EBITDA INR128 crore, 15.6%) and total pigment global business revenue of INR2,695 crore with business EBITDA of INR242 crore versus INR2,327 crore and INR90 crore a year earlier. The VP4 raw material business was sold for EUR75.8 million (closed 2 November 2026) and proceeds are earmarked for debt reduction, while net debt stood at INR580 crore at September end before those proceeds. RIECO was a weak spot, with Q2 revenue of INR47 crore and negative EBITDA of INR3 crore due to internal supply-chain bottlenecks and cost overruns on two late-stage projects. Management kept the Acquired Group guidance unchanged despite H1 progress, citing caution on demand and a first normal full-year cycle post-acquisition.

segments.name: Legacy Sudarshan pigments
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue INR821 crore with EBITDA INR128 crore (15.6%); H1 revenue up 26% with 16.5% business EBITDA margin. Management split growth roughly equally between price and volume, with some Q2 sales pulled forward from October ahead of SAP go-live.

segments.name: Acquired Group (ex-Heubach)
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue INR1,962 crore with business EBITDA INR112 crore; H1 business EBITDA margin 6.1% versus 2% a year ago. Growth was almost entirely price, with muted volume growth.

segments.name: RIECO
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue INR47 crore and EBITDA negative INR3 crore, attributed to internal supply-chain execution issues. Two late-stage projects had cost overruns fully accounted for in Q2.

segments.name: Aluminium dyes (Clariant toll manufacturing)
segments.commentary: Definitive agreements signed to acquire the manufacturing business from Clariant, including a Swiss site; closing expected early next year. Management cited product-approval sensitivity to site.

guidance_outlook: Acquired Group FY27 guidance reaffirmed at EUR700 million revenue and EUR35 million EBITDA, already net of the VP4 divestment EBITDA loss; management said H1 run-rate is already near EUR35 million.
Management expects demand signs towards Q4 FY27, though not immediate; European manufacturing index has moved positively and some raw material prices have stabilised.
SAP integration (one system from four) expected to complete by mid-FY28; wave one (Sudarshan legacy and Heubach India) is live.
Europe headcount restructuring costs INR74 crore; management expects annual savings similar to or slightly above that amount, phased in over about 1.5 years from the year-end agreement.

Value capture target of EUR90-100 million over three to four years was referenced by an analyst; management cited backward integration, AI and further purchasing and manufacturing savings as the remaining levers.
Board is evaluating capital allocation options including buybacks, with a full plan expected in about a year; no decision announced.
capex_capacity: VP4 raw material business sold to a customer for EUR75.8 million; closed 2 November 2026 with funds fully received. Captive use retained by Sudarshan is 5-10% of volume, single-digit.
Clariant aluminium dyes toll manufacturing being converted to ownership via definitive agreements, including a Swiss site; closing expected early next year.
Some products the Acquired Group makes in Europe are not yet made in India; transfer would require new physical capacity investment (IP exists, but no physical assets in India for these molecules).
Production of commoditised products has moved to India, but management said full commercialisation and cost benefit has not yet been realised.
demand_pricing: Overall US housing and European construction remain weak; masterbatch demand volatile due to oil and polymer price swings.
Customer destocking is over per management, but customers are buying only as needed; demand remains muted amid geopolitical uncertainty.

Lead times for raw materials and finished-goods deliveries have lengthened, leading to inventory build; inventory absolute level up about 25% versus 31 March 2026 per analyst; management said inventory days still improved versus H1 FY26.
Win-back of lost global key accounts (mainly Europe and US-headquartered) is underway, with business returning in coatings and digital inks; losses were spread across multiple competitors.
Innovation pipeline reopened with launches in cosmetics, cell phone and digital ink applications, plus heavy-metal-free dyes and colourants for recycled plastics; new products are margin-accretive.

qa_highlights.question: How much of revenue improvement is volume versus price, and has lost share from the Heubach insolvency period been regained?
qa_highlights.answer: Legacy Sudarshan growth split roughly half price and half volume, excluding some SAP-related pull-forward sales from October into September. Acquired Group growth was almost all price with muted volume. Management said win-backs are ongoing with global key accounts.

qa_highlights.question: Why was Acquired Group FY27 EBITDA guidance not upgraded when H1 is about two-thirds done, and is VP4 EBITDA loss included?
qa_highlights.answer: VP4 loss is included in the retained EUR35 million guidance. Management said it is being cautious because this is the first normal full-year cycle post-acquisition; it does not expect a Q3-like weak quarter.

qa_highlights.question: Captive use of VP4 product: 5% earlier versus 10% in the deck?
qa_highlights.answer: Management clarified captive use is between 5% and 10%, depending on demand, and in single digits.

qa_highlights.question: Why did Europe restructuring cost INR74 crore and what are savings and timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Restructuring affects support functions, not direct manufacturing. Annual savings expected similar to or slightly above INR74 crore, phasing in over about 1.5 years.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company buy back shares or use cash, given expected net cash?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the board, not the promoter group, is evaluating options; a full capital-allocation plan is expected in about a year. VP4 proceeds will go to debt reduction.

qa_highlights.question: What levers close the margin gap from about 6-6.5% toward 9-10% on EUR90-100 million EBITDA?
qa_highlights.answer: Achieved so far: org structure cuts, manufacturing yield and utility savings, global purchasing. Pending: backward integration, AI use, production shifts to India, and one to two percentage points from volume recovery.

qa_highlights.question: Destocking status and inventory increase?
qa_highlights.answer: Customer destocking is over. Inventory rose because of longer raw material and finished-goods lead times and demand variability; days still improved versus H1 FY26.

qa_highlights.question: Confidence in outgrowing a 3-4% global pigment market, given FY29 aspiration of about 9% growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said two-thirds of EBITDA growth aspiration comes from internal cost reduction and one-third from sales growth, driven by regaining lost business.

risks_watch: Acquired Group FY27 EBITDA guidance (EUR35 million) left unchanged despite strong H1; watch whether Q3 and Q4 deliver run-rate.
RIECO execution issues and cost overruns on two late-stage projects; negative Q2 EBITDA.
Inventory up about 25% from 31 March 2026 with rising lead times; working-capital target of further EUR15-20 million reduction in FY27 is at risk.
Win-back of lost global key accounts is ongoing and not yet quantified; FY29 growth aspiration (about 9%) is well above the 3-4% industry rate.
Clariant aluminium dye site closing and the SAP integration (mid-FY28) carry execution risk.
Capital allocation (buyback, merger with Sudarshan Colorants) remains undecided; no timeline beyond about one year.
summary.management_tone: Confident on operational turnaround and EBITDA gains, but cautious on the outlook: management repeatedly cited weak European and US demand, geopolitics and freight costs as reasons not to raise guidance. Answers on the RIECO issues, inventory build and FY29 growth targets were more general, and several questions on capital allocation and the merger with Sudarshan Colorants were deferred.
key_quotes: We want to reaffirm strongly our guidance for the Acquired Group, EUR 700 million and EUR 35 million of EBITDA.

We don't expect such a subdued quarter this quarter, but we are tending cautiously because this is the first normal two, three quarter, which we are going to experience as we have acquired this business.
From the customers' bit, I think the destocking is over and I am hoping that it is over because it cannot be forever and ever.
We've closed this deal on November 2nd , 2026 at a value of EUR75.8 million, and we've received all the funds, and all the closing activities have been successfully completed.
I think most of the improvement, Manjeet, came from the acquired group.

growth.why: Acquired Group FY27 guidance of EUR700m revenue and EUR35m EBITDA was reaffirmed, with H1 EBITDA run-rate near EUR35m, but backing is partial: H1 growth was mostly price with muted volume, demand remains weak, and no new capacity is tied to the guidance beyond the Clariant dyes toll-to-ownership deal closing early next year.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Legacy pigment EBITDA margin 15.6% in Q2 and 16.5% in H1 (vs INR172 crore H1 FY26), Acquired Group business EBITDA margin 6.1% in H1 vs 2% a year ago, and EUR90-100m value-capture levers (INR74 crore Europe restructuring with savings similar to that amount) are pending, though Acquired Group FY27 guidance was held and Q2 was partly pull-forward.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: No new physical capacity is committed in the brief; the Clariant aluminium dyes toll-to-ownership closing early next year is an acquisition, and moving Europe-made molecules to India would need new capacity with no timing given.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Legacy growth was roughly half volume (H1 revenue up 26% YoY) but Acquired Group growth was almost all price with muted volume, and management sees demand signs only towards Q4 FY27 while European and US housing and construction remain weak.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Utilisation is not disclosed and capital allocation is deferred to a plan in about a year; VP4 sale and debt reduction point to deleveraging rather than new capex.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Acquired Group FY27 guidance of EUR700m revenue and EUR35m EBITDA was reaffirmed, not raised, despite H1 EBITDA run-rate near EUR35m, with management citing weak demand, geopolitics and freight costs.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: RIECO Q2 EBITDA was negative INR3 crore on INR47 crore revenue, inventory is up about 25% versus 31 March 2026, and the EUR15-20m working-capital reduction target is at risk.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Innovation pipeline has reopened with launches in cosmetics, cell phone and digital inks, plus heavy-metal-free dyes for recycled plastics, which management says are margin-accretive.

rows.label: Win-back of lost global key accounts
rows.why: Business is already returning in coatings and digital inks from Europe- and US-headquartered accounts, though management has not quantified it.

rows.label: Europe headcount restructuring savings
rows.why: INR74 crore restructuring cost is expected to yield annual savings similar to or slightly above INR74 crore, phased in over about 1.5 years.

rows.label: Capital allocation plan (buyback / merger)
rows.why: Board is evaluating buybacks and the Sudarshan Colorants merger, with a full plan expected in about a year and no decision yet; VP4 proceeds of EUR75.8m go to debt reduction and net debt was INR580 crore before them.
